## `server-mod`

A server mod (`[entry] server` in `mod.toml`). Runs in the dedicated server or the host of a local world.

| | Interface |
| --- | --- |
| include | `core` |
| export | `guest` |

## `client-mod`

A client mod (`[entry] client`). Runs in the game client (PC port or Android loader). In 0.1 it gets the same core imports; player-join, player-quit and kicks are server-only, and `players` lists the players the client knows about. Client-specific interfaces (HUD, input, rendering, assets) arrive with milestone M6.

| | Interface |
| --- | --- |
| include | `core` |
| export | `guest` |
